title: Support returning SymInt beyond constant integer in torch.cond
body:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

Current torch.cond supports returning a tuple of tensors or constant ints. When the true branch and the false branch returns different integer constants, the returned value will be merged into a SymInt type. However, there is currently no support for directly returning SymInt values in the true branch or false branch. This functionality is very helpful in real applications when doing tensor shape computation due to the fundamental nature of control flow. I believe this feature should be quite easy to implement as the SymInt return type is already largely available in torch.cond.

### Alternatives

The feature is very simple so no need to provide alternatives.

### Additional context

This functionality is crucial. Control-flow for SymInt computation can become much more powerful with this feature.
